Name: Dynamic Reflections
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/Ur5ac0r.png[/img]
[size=3][b]Dynamic Reflections[/b] is a framework which enables mirror and [size=3]water [/size]reflections within Stardew Valley.

Dynamic Reflections introduces many features:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Water reflection for both vanilla and modded locations[/size]
[*][size=3]Puddles that generate during and after rainy days, which are both reflective and splashy[/size]
[*][size=3]Stars and comets that appear within bodies of water during non-rainy days[/size]
[*][size=3]Mirror reflections added via map tiles and [size=3]modded furniture[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Customizable reflection effects, such as waviness, color, height and more![/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Support for player, NPCs, terrain objects, player buildings and furniture[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e0yBHUE.png[/img]

[size=3]See the GitHub repository for an [url=https://github.com/Floogen/DynamicReflections/wiki]in-depth wiki[/url] on how to create a content pack for Dynamic Reflections.
[size=3]
See the example pack in the [b]Optional Files [/b]section for an example interior which uses mirrors via a Solid Foundation custom building.[/size][size=3]

See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12834]Fashionable Mirrors[/url] for a DR pack which utilizes Dynamic Game Assets.[/size][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] is supported![/b][/b][/size][b]
[/b][size=3][b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] is supported![/b][/b][/size][b]


[img]https://imgur.com/elFaout.png[/img]
[size=3]To use this framework for water reflections, simply download it and config it to your liking. [/size][/b][size=3]

You may optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily change the water reflection and other settings while in-game.


Dynamic Reflection (DR) content packs may also be downloaded, which add reflections to modded furniture (currently via DGA).

Removing downloaded DR packs will result in their respective furniture no longer have reflections, but will otherwise have no impact on your game.[/size][b][size=3]


[img]https://imgur.com/McBoaEB.png[/img][/size][/b][size=3]
For a general example pack, see the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/DynamicReflections/tree/development/DynamicReflections/Examples]mod's repository[/url].

[/size][size=3]For a pack which uses Dynamic Reflections and Dynamic Game Assets, see the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12834]Fashionable Mirrors pack.[/url][/size][b]

[size=3][b]Can I uninstall Dynamic Reflections without issue?[/b]
[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Yes![/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Can I uninstall Dynamic Reflections content packs without issue?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Yes, though the respective modded furniture will lose their reflective surfaces.[/size]
[/list]


Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/DynamicReflections]available here[/url].
